title: Ticketmaster Insights
description: Strategic audience behavior and event lifecycle management tool.
longDescription: A specialized portal that transforms raw event data into actionable marketing strategies, helping clients identify and target high-propensity audiences. Focused on UI/UX optimization and frontend performance to ensure intuitive data discovery for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Waterfall Distribution Engine
description: High-precision financial logic for real-time investment distributions.
longDescription: An automated engine that handles complex multi-tier profit sharing and capital distributions for real estate and private equity funds. Developed Waterfall V2, enhancing the system's ability to process multi-class investor hurdles and catch-up clauses. Focused on precision, auditability, and algorithm optimization.

title: LiveAnalytics Platform (Ticketmaster)
description: Data-driven marketing and measurement for global live events.
longDescription: A high-traffic analytics platform that provides event organizers with real-time insights into sales, inventory, and fan engagement metrics. Engineered new features for the MERN stack-based platform, optimizing data visualization components to handle massive concurrent traffic spikes during major event on-sales.

title: Digital Engagement Hub (Finacle - Speedboat)
description: Omnichannel banking platform powering seamless customer journeys.
longDescription: An enterprise-class system designed to help banks onboard, service, and engage customers across mobile, web, and chat channels. Built responsive, DDA-compliant web interfaces and developed RESTful APIs to integrate the hub with core banking and payment systems.
